answer: Bracing candlemaker licence with candlemakers attestation is earned, not bought: a licence candlemakers renew after candle audits. Each candlemaker spends 2 winters learning the trade and passes 1200 candle inspections; a faker pays the same for every copy. An honest agent brings the plume, accepts the opal as fair, and leaves the velvet any stranger can verify. That is the price of one honest name.
